title: univariate-forecasting-result.v1
description: Project Spec S0246: strict, persisted schema for a governed Atlas-native univariate-forecasting runtime prediction result -- the schema named (but not implemented) by inference_bundle.v2's output_schema.result_schema_version (Project Spec S0245). Mirrors contracts/continuous-regression-result.schema.json's shape discipline: a governed identity plus an ordered multi-step forecast series and the frozen model_descriptor. Cross-field cardinality/order/finiteness/future-index rules that JSON Schema cannot express (len(forecast_points) == forecast_horizon, horizon_step sequence 1..H, future_time_index strictly progressing from forecast_origin) must be enforced separately by the runtime validator. Never includes an observed target, history rows, a residual, a confidence/prediction interval, training metrics, release metadata, or external-study metadata.

forecast_origin.description: The last validated history time-index value the forecast was generated from. Never a boolean.

frequency.description: The governed logical frequency the forecast series advances by. Never a pandas/NumPy/statsmodels-specific alias vocabulary.

display_name.description: Deterministic projection of model_family via a fixed code mapping. Never editable profile copy.

future_time_index.description: Deterministic future time-index value, strictly after the forecast origin. Never a boolean.

forecast.description: Finite numeric forecast value. Never rounded, bucketed, or dataset-unit-labeled by this contract.
